newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CDL says expects sound 1997 result.
newsitem.headline: CDL says expects sound 1997 result.

text.p: CDL Hotels New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday it expected another sound financial result in the 1997 year with likely enhancement in 1998 and beyond.
Chairman Bruce Davidson told the annual meeting the continuing initiatives being adopted by the company would enable CDL to outperform the market.
CDL made a net profit of NZ$15.47 million in the year to December, down 26 percent on the year ago period.
CDL is majority owned by CDL Hotels International, which ultimately controlled by Singapore's Hong Leong Group.
